section_label: Suitability as Herbicides and Plant Protection Agents
notes: Named as the herbicidal active substance of the plant protection agents. The section names the known amorphous tembotrione and the crystalline forms A and C of it. No reaction takes place, so no synthetic role applies and role is other.

section_label: Suitability as Herbicides and Plant Protection Agents
notes: Same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity. This is form A. Stated to be suitable as a herbicide and superior to amorphous tembotrione in handling and formulation properties.

section_label: Suitability as Herbicides and Plant Protection Agents
notes: Same molecule as tembotrione, differing only in crystal lattice; it is not a distinct chemical entity. This is form C. Stated to be suitable as a herbicide and superior to amorphous tembotrione in handling and formulation properties. The section prints the form only inside the phrases "forms A and C" and "form A or C", so no printed alias is carried.
